[
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1‑3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as facial lesions (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genital lesions.",
  "A consensus rate of 100 % (21/21) supports the recommendation that surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be determined based on tumor thickness.",
  "When indicated, sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and, whenever possible, in the same operative setting.",
  "The 7‑point score includes an atypical pigment network characterized by irregular meshes and thickened lines.",
  "The 7‑point score includes irregular streaks characterized by unevenly distributed radial lines or pseudopods.",
  "The 7‑point score does not include other major or minor features such as blue‑whitish veil, pigmentation, dots/globules, or regression structures.",
  "The recommendation that surgical excision with histologically negative margins is first‑line treatment is supported by PMID 39709737.",
  "The recommendation that sentinel lymph node biopsy should precede wide excision is supported by PMID 30392755."
]
